evidence: Built a criterion -> public requirement map for all 53 criteria (2 gates, 41 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Each one traces to instruction.md or hireops_rules.md, to the shared template convention (sign-in), or to a plain professional default. GATES: render hro_gate_render (render/judge.toml:22-24) covers wrong-password refusal and sign-in. Sign-in is house convention (SKILL.md known false positive; Internal sheet row 27), and it is also public anyway (instruction.md:17, rules s1). constraints hro_gate_shared (constraints/judge.toml:22-24) has a recruiter open a job and add a candidate that the Observer then sees; rules s1 table 'opens jobs, adds candidates', s2, and 'Observer reads the board'. FUNCTIONAL, intake: hro_job_open's blank title, places 0/51/2.5 and non-manager HM map to rules s2 'a whole number from 1 to 50', 'chosen from the hiring-manager accounts'. hro_add_candidate's bottom of Applied maps to s2 'The card starts at the bottom of Applied'. hro_add_email_rules (field-level error, typed values kept, case-insensitive duplicate, other job accepted) maps to s2 verbatim. FUNCTIONAL, board: hro_move_one_stage maps to s3 'one stage at a time... Skipping a stage is refused', 'appears on the mover's board immediately', non-drag. hro_arrive_bottom and hro_reorder map to s3 Order. hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired and hro_reopen (including undo restoring the reason) map to s3 Moving and Undo 'restores a rejection reason that the move removed'. hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free and hro_undo_full map to s3 Interview places and Undo 'or if it would overfill Interview'. hro_refused_put_back's focus on the card's controls maps to s3 'keyboard focus stays on that card's controls'. FUNCTIONAL, roles: hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused and hro_mgr_other_job map to s3 Who may move what ('only among Interview, Offer and Hired... Everything else is refused') and s1 'Only a recruiter opens a job'. hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff and hro_anonymous (401) map to s1 '401'/'403'/'404' and s7 'every staff action are refused to candidates'. hro_refusal_status's 403/404/409 codes map to s1 and s3 '(409)'. That is a public status contract, not an invented route. FUNCTIONAL, concurrency, bulk and undo: hro_stale_refused maps to s3 'Two people at once' plus instruction 'tell me who'. hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none and hro_bulk_places map to s3 Moving several ('in board order', 'Interview places are counted for the whole set', 'none of them moves'). hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict and hro_undo_once map to s3 Undo; I traced protocol B (functional/prompt.md:35) and in step 12 Mei's one-place re-order of Y in Screen [Y,W,X,Z,A2] does not shift A2, so the 'different card' control is sound. FUNCTIONAL, activity and live: hro_activity and hro_activity_refusals map to s4 ('newest first for all jobs or one chosen job', 'A refused action adds no entry'; notes are explicitly exempt). hro_live_board maps to s5 '15 seconds'. FUNCTIONAL, conversations: hro_msg_compose maps to s6 Messages (plain text, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty and focused box, 'Sending clears the draft'). hro_thread_latest and hro_thread_earlier map to s6 Long conversations (30, 'count still to come'). hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up and hro_seen map to s6 Unread/Seen and s5 'seen marks arrive'. hro_thread_access maps to s6 Who takes part. hro_drafts maps to s6 Drafts. FUNCTIONAL, candidates and restart: hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private and hro_candidate_linked map to s7 table and leak list ('a card's place on the board', 'stage a card was rejected from') and s2 'that application is theirs'. hro_restart maps to instruction.md:15 'Load ... once... keep new work across restarts' and integration.md 'seeding never duplicates'. Seed-derived expectations check out against seed_data.json: Lena APP-301 has 3 messages and read_count 2, so 1 unread. Platform Applied is Greta(1), Ade(2), Marco(3); Screen is Priya(1), Samuel(2). Noor APP-101's note text matches, and APP-101 has 120 messages. POLISH: hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread map to instruction.md:5,7 and rules s5 (typing, focus, open card, scroll). hro_pol_earlier_place maps to s6 'the message that was at the top of the view stays where it was'. hro_pol_failed_send maps to s6 'stays in the box, and the person is told it was not sent'. hro_pol_session_resume maps to instruction.md:7 'get signed out... when I sign back in it is still there, and nobody else who signs in on that browser sees it', s6 Drafts and s3 Internal notes 'kept for that person on that browser until it is saved'. VISUAL: desktop-only and single theme, with visual/prompt.md:14 'No phone layout or theme switching is required'. This respects instruction.md:11 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'. The template's mobile/theme criteria (responsive_layout, visual_responsive_consistency, 'every theme') were correctly dropped, so nothing grades the explicitly disclaimed features. The prompts repeatedly disclaim routes, selectors, labels and layout (app_context.md:33-34, functional/prompt.md:15,17 'Never call a route the UI was not seen to use'). Replays reuse observed request shapes only. No exact label, exact route or reference-only rule is asserted. RESIDUAL INSTANCES (Notes, not demonstrated false-fails). (a) hro_stale_refused (functional/judge.toml:208-209) is exercised by a page.evaluate replay (protocol C, prompt.md:33), so in practice the 409 response body must identify the changer by name or by a staff-visible identifier. A conforming UI that composes 'changed by Mei Lin' from a follow-up board fetch would be told-who on screen in real use but fail the replay. This is narrowed by the 'identifier' allowance; the golden puts the activity detail in the 409 message (src/index.js:242-244). (b) hro_add_candidate (judge.toml:38) asks for email and source 'wherever the app shows card details'. The strict reading requires both on the details surface. Rules s2/s3 only say a card opens 'to show its details', so this rests on professional default (the golden shows both, board.js:130). (c) hro_seen 'shows as not seen' (judge.toml:362) could be read as requiring an explicit not-seen marker. Rules s6 'shows whether it has been seen' supports a binary display, and absence of 'Seen' should suffice. All three are interpretive P3 risks with no observed false-fail. RISK=true because, per raw-evidence-index.json scope, 'Full configured grading/workload... and Oracle/target scores are absent'. The only empirical test of 'no false-fail on correct apps' is the configured judge run on the golden (and ideally a conforming alternative), and that remains unmeasured. The scripted golden driver is not judge execution.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not required to pass this row: in hro_stale_refused, also accept identification shown on the page's own UI-path refusal (or state in rules s3 that the refusal response itself names who). In hro_add_candidate, write 'if the app shows card details, they show the entered email and source' explicitly. In hro_seen, say 'shows as not seen (an unseen state or the absence of a seen mark)'. Obtain a full configured judge run on the golden to measure false-fails.
